notes.title: Version 1.01 is live! Brazilian-Portuguese language added
notes.content:
Hello dear members of #vamily! I hope my message finds you well!

It’s my great pleasure to inform you that the waiting is finally over and you can now play Vampire: The Masquerade: Shadows of New York in Brazilian-Portuguese!

Thank you so much for your patience and understanding! It has been a long process, but thanks to the hard work and skills of Shadows’ Brazilian-Portuguese team of translators and great effort made by our QA and implementation team, the update is now live!

Next to adding Brazilian-Portuguese (as well as French and Russian!) language to the game, the latest patch (version 1.0.10) also includes a few minor bug fixes.

For those of you, who already tasted the full Lasombra expierience, take a look at Coteries of New York - our first Vampire: The Masquerade game, which lets you play a young, newly born vampire, representing one of three iconic Clans: Ventrue, Brujah or Toreador and learn what does it mean to live a Kindred's life on the streets of Big Apple! Go through the trailer and the game's description and if you like what you see, buy Coteries of New York right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096410/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York/

We encourage all of you to join our official Discord server, where you can talk directly with both Coteries’ and Shadows’ developers!

notes.title: Serial Cleaners – a glimpse of our upcoming game
notes.content:
Hello dear members of #vamily! I hope my message finds you in good health!

While part of our team is responsible for overseeing the progress the translators make with bringing new language versions to Coteries and Shadows, the majority of the development team works on Serial Cleaners – a single player, isometric stealth action game – a sequel to our game Serial Cleaner, which boasts more than 1,3 million owners on all platforms around the world!

Serial Cleaners tell the story of four cleaners for the mob – shady figures, whose task is to clean after gangsters in New York city in the 90s. Each and every character has a personality and skill set of his own and while the complex story evolves, players will taste four distinct playstyles – from very tactical and stealthy to fast and ruthless. All of this in the delicious sauce of Jean Michel Basquiat’s-inspired art style and music from the era.

That said we encourage you to take a look at an actual work-in-progress gameplay, recorded in-game, which dynamically shows the process of creating the map, as well as one of protagonists - Lati, moving around the level, when the cops are arriving to the scene! And the scene itself is one and only 5Pointz, one of the most iconic mural spaces in the world! Check it out below!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i4frMErq1Ds

If you like what you see, you may be interested in adding Serial Cleaners to your wishlist and follow to stay updated with all the latest information, screenshots and trailers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337920?snr=1_2108_9__2107

As always, we encourage you to join our official Discord channel, where you can talk directly with both our Vampire: The Masquerade titles, as well as with Serial Cleaners' developers!

Serial Cleaners will launch in 2021.

Take care and stay healthy!
Best regards,
Jacek @ Draw Distance development team

notes.title: Wow, there will be a new Werewolf: The Apocalypse game!
notes.content:
Hello dear members of #vamily, I hope our announcement finds you in good health!

You learned everything about Vampire: The Masquerade through our gameand other fully licensed VtM products, but World of Darkness is much more than that. There are Mages, Wraiths... and Werewolves. Thanks to our buddies from Different Tales, soon you will be able to find out a lot more about the entire Werewolf: The Apocalypse setting. 

Written by the people behind The Witcher 1 and 2, and the Wanderlust series, Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest is going to be a pen-and-paper-like experience set in Europe's last primeval forest.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aQ7CulMwjHk

Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Heart of the Forest takes place in modern times, in a real ancient wilderness called Puszcza Białowieska. You'll explore it as Maia, a young woman looking to uncover the truth about her family. 

During your adventure, you'll come upon many real myths and places surrounding the forest. You'll also find yourself in the middle of an ancient conflict between the protectors of Gaia and the forces that want to destroy her.

The special thing about Heart of the Forest is that, much like Coteries of New York, the game itself is the Game Master. It tells you a story, and you decide how to deal with each situation considering your stats or inclination. We’ve always found this approach stylish and exciting. 

Follow & wishlist Heart of the Forest and let us know what you think!

Follow Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Heart of the Forest

Stay well and healthy!

Jace @ Draw Distance dev team
